records.title: Study on schoolyard regreening and urban cool islands

authority.basis: The City procurement dataset is competent for the contract metadata it publishes and labels the amount field as a fixed or estimated maximum amount excluding tax.
limitations: The record establishes a study service contract, not a works contract.
The dataset does not establish invoice, payment, delivery, outcome, causal impact, or campaign-to-programme continuity.

amount.aggregation_rule: Use the value once for procurement identifier 20202012301.

establishes: The City dataset reports procurement identifier 20202012301 for a schoolyard-regreening study notified on 27 November 2020.
The published contract value is EUR 45,750 excluding tax at the procurement-service stage.
does_not_establish: Direct fulfillment of the campaign commitment

records.title: Schoolyard-regreening design and user-assistance competition

authority.basis: The official BOAMP notice is competent for the published competition, procedure dates, and lot scopes.
limitations: The notice establishes a competition for services, not a contract award, works, payment, or completion.
The official catalog does not state a dataset licence, so only governed metadata and the response fingerprint are retained.

establishes: BOAMP published a two-lot competition on 5 October 2025 for schoolyard-regreening design and user-assistance services.
Lot 2 jointly covers Pierre-et-Marie-Curie and Alphonse-Daudet.
does_not_establish: A school-specific allocation within a multi-school lot
Payment, competent completion, outcome, or impact
A relationship to the Pierre-et-Marie-Curie maternal courtyard reported in 2023

records.title: Award of schoolyard-regreening design and user-assistance services

authority.basis: The BOAMP award notice reports the award decisions, lot-to-contract mapping, awardees, and values; the City dataset independently reports the same contract references and values and labels its amount field as excluding tax.
limitations: The award notice was published on 15 January 2026 and the contracts were issued in January 2026, after the observation cut-off.
The records concern design and user-assistance services, not works, payment, or completion.
The Pierre-et-Marie-Curie lot also covers Alphonse-Daudet and cannot be allocated to one school without a more granular record.

amount.aggregation_rule: Sum the two unique lot contract values once; never sum repeated City holder-grain rows.

lots.holder: SAS ATELIER DU ROUGET SIMON TEYSSOU & ASSOCIÉS

establishes: The notice reports two service awards dated 26 November 2025.
The published values are EUR 81,500 for contract 25-119 and EUR 76,800 for contract 25-120.
The City dataset independently reports the same contract references and values at holder grain.
does_not_establish: A contemporaneously published award record at the 2025 cut-off
A school-specific allocation within either multi-school lot
Invoice, payment, competent completion, outcome, or impact
A relationship to the Pierre-et-Marie-Curie maternal courtyard reported in 2023

quality_findings.finding: The City response contains eight holder-grain rows for three procurement identifiers and repeats each contract amount for every listed holder or role.
quality_findings.evidence: Contract 25-119 appears four times at EUR 81,500 and contract 25-120 appears three times at EUR 76,800. Summing raw rows produces EUR 602,150; deduplicating by procurement identifier produces EUR 204,050 including the 2020 study.
quality_findings.impact: A row-level sum would overstate the selected published contract values by EUR 398,100 and could mislead financial reporting.
quality_findings.remediation: Use procurement identifier as the amount grain, preserve holders as a separate repeating dimension, and add a no-double-counting invariant.

quality_findings.finding: The marche_nature and marche_type values change semantic position between the selected 2020 and 2025-labelled records.
quality_findings.evidence: The 2020 row reports marche_nature=Marché and marche_type=Services; the 2025-labelled rows report marche_nature=Services and marche_type=Marché.
quality_findings.impact: A single field mapping across years could reverse contract nature and service type.
quality_findings.remediation: Normalize record by record using controlled values and corroborate the 2025 procedure with BOAMP instead of trusting one portal column globally.

quality_findings.finding: The award event is dated before the observation cut-off, but the award notice and contract issue dates are after it.
quality_findings.evidence: Award date: 26 November 2025; contract issue dates: 5 and 6 January 2026; award-notice publication: 15 January 2026.
quality_findings.impact: Treating the later publication as contemporaneous 2025 evidence would create time-travel in the historical snapshot.
quality_findings.remediation: Expose it as post-cut-off historical evidence and do not silently recompute the 2025 fulfillment conclusion.

quality_findings.finding: The lot naming Pierre-et-Marie-Curie also covers Alphonse-Daudet and does not identify the maternal or elementary school unit.
quality_findings.evidence: BOAMP LOT-0002 names both school groups; the current pilot separately reports the Pierre maternal unit completed in 2023 and the elementary unit forthcoming.
quality_findings.impact: The lot value and award cannot be assigned to the 2023 maternal delivery or to one school without unsupported allocation.
quality_findings.remediation: Require a scope-bearing contract annex, purchase order, invoice, or accounting record before linking the award to a pilot school unit.

quality_findings.finding: The official BOAMP catalog metadata does not state a dataset licence.
quality_findings.evidence: The catalog returned null for both license and license_url on 30 July 2026.
quality_findings.impact: Repository redistribution of the 29,026-byte raw response cannot be approved under the current rights rule.
quality_findings.remediation: Retain the fingerprint and minimal governed metadata only until qualified rights review establishes the reuse basis.

limitations: The bundle documents candidate study, competition, and award evidence for services only; the source records do not name the Respire à la récré programme.
No record in this bundle establishes attributable schoolyard works, transaction-level payment, competent acceptance, outcome, causal impact, or fulfillment.
The award notice is post-cut-off evidence about a reported pre-cut-off award date and remains excluded from contemporaneous 2025 publication claims.
The public prototype must not allocate multi-school lot values to one school or sum holder-grain duplicates.
